component.name: Cadex
component.summary: Terminal, editor, git and notes in one Wayland window

description.p: Cadex is a terminal-centric development workspace: terminal tabs and splits, an editor with tree-sitter highlights, Markdown notes with a live preview, git status and history, search across the workspace, SSH hosts and Claude session history.
The Linux app is a preview and runs on Wayland with GTK4.
